name: Forecast View
description: Sales forecast roll-up: per-rep stacked bars (closed / commit / best case / pipeline) against a quota marker, inline manager overrides, call-basis switch, and team quota, gap and pipeline-coverage KPIs.

props.name: reps
props.description: { id, name, avatar?, team?, quota, closedWon, commit, bestCase, pipeline }

props.name: period
props.description: Period label shown in the header

props.name: overrides
props.description: Controlled manager overrides of each rep's call

props.name: onOverridesChange
props.description: Fires when an override is set or cleared

props.name: callBasis
props.description: Initial category counted as the rep's call

usage: repCall(rep, basis) is exported for server-side roll-ups.
